entries.response.turn.opening.text: We have enough people to stop surviving from one night to the next. Pick a place, mark it as ours, and we can simulan gusali something that lasts.
entries.response.turn.opening.offer.set_territor: Then let us find ground worth defending. I will tulong turn it into home.
entries.textRows.locked.base_established: Ang aming teritoryo ay naitatag na.
